title: Open Values Presentation Strings v1.0
description: The words the shared page layer shows to readers: names for the main things a person works with, coverage messages, button labels and error messages. Maintainers write it, and the presentation build copies it into the package the app reads.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-presentation-strings.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

updated.description: The date the strings were last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD. The presentation package uses it as its built date.

locale.description: The language of the strings, as a language code. The build currently accepts only en.

signedVocabulary.description: The names for the main things a person works with, such as My rules and The baseline, approved by the founder in the 2026-07-15 plain-words review. The build fails if any of them change.

search.description: Words for the search box and for the page shown when a search or address finds nothing.

objectTypes.description: The display name for each kind of thing a page can be about, such as Decision, Source or Company, keyed by type.

coverage.description: The five evidence states an answer can be in, each with a label, a sentence and an action. The labels are fixed and the build fails if they change.

rich.description: Sources cover the decisive facts in the answer.

thin.description: Some facts in the answer lack enough source detail.

lowEvidence.description: Too much is missing to rank the choices reliably.

notCovered.description: The decision is on the map but has no comparison yet.

unavailable.description: The original source could not be opened, so the stored citation is shown instead.

fieldStates.description: Short messages shown in place of a missing or empty field, such as when a source was not supplied or ownership is unknown, keyed by state.

evidenceKinds.description: The labels for the three kinds of evidence: measured, certified, and assessed from public evidence. The build fails if they change.

appliedValues.description: Copy for the panel that explains why an answer ranks first.

label.description: The panel heading. Always Why this answer.

templates.description: The six sentence templates that explain a ranking, keyed by case, such as baselineOnly or personalRule. Words in braces, like {answer} or {decisiveFact}, are filled in when the page is drawn.

actions.description: Button labels inside the panel, such as Change My rules, keyed by action.
Button and link labels used across pages, such as Save this choice or Read source, keyed by action. Words in braces are filled in when the page is drawn.

errors.description: Error messages, keyed by error, such as an invalid address or a file that could not be imported. Words in braces are filled in when the message is shown.

label.description: The short label shown for this state.

sentence.description: A sentence explaining the state. Words in braces, like {source} or {missing}, are filled in when the page is drawn.

action.description: The label of the action offered in this state, such as See the sources.
